title: Detailed robot vacuum
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='38' ry='8' fill='#1a2a4a'/>
  <!-- body base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='36' ry='22' fill='#6a7a9a'/>
  <!-- body top disc -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='36' ry='20' fill='#9aa8c4'/>
  <!-- top surface -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='30' ry='15' fill='#c4d0e4'/>
  <!-- bumper front -->
  <path d='M14,62 Q14,80 50,80 Q86,80 86,62' fill='none' stroke='#3a4a6a' stroke-width='4'/>
  <!-- bumper highlight -->
  <path d='M18,63 Q18,77 50,77' fill='none' stroke='#7a8aa8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- lidar tower -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#5a6a8a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#8a9ab8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='39' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#3a4a6a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='39' r='2' fill='#60e0ff'/>
  <!-- display screen on top -->
  <rect x='34' y='52' width='32' height='14' rx='4' fill='#1a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='59' r='3' fill='#60e0ff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='59' r='3' fill='#60e0ff'/>
  <path d='M45,62 Q50,65 55,62' fill='none' stroke='#60e0ff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- side wheel left -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='74' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#2a3a5a'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='74' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#5a6a8a'/>
  <!-- side wheel right -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='74' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#2a3a5a'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='74' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#5a6a8a'/>
  <!-- side brush left -->
  <g transform='translate(16,68)'>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='2.5' fill='#60e0ff'/>
    <line x1='0' y1='0' x2='-8' y2='-6' stroke='#40b0d0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='0' y1='0' x2='8' y2='-7' stroke='#40b0d0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='0' y1='0' x2='-6' y2='7' stroke='#40b0d0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- side brush right -->
  <g transform='translate(84,68)'>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='2.5' fill='#60e0ff'/>
    <line x1='0' y1='0' x2='8' y2='-6' stroke='#40b0d0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='0' y1='0' x2='-8' y2='-7' stroke='#40b0d0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='0' y1='0' x2='6' y2='7' stroke='#40b0d0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sensor dots on bumper -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='68' r='1.5' fill='#60e0ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='72' r='1.5' fill='#60e0ff'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='68' r='1.5' fill='#60e0ff'/>
  <!-- top button -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='2' fill='#ff8a9a'/>
</svg>
